page.layout: One block of verse in the centre of the page, 26 lines, ending with the initials "I. C." set right below it. Page number top right. Running head top left.

main_text.l: Fœdifragi iustas Hispani conspice pœnas,
Et iam latus Avo gratare, Patriq; ubique.
Armorum furiis actus, dum more Gigantum
Hispanus coelo parat impia bella tyrannus,
Effera producit truculento examina fastu,
Et iubet audaces pelago committere sylvas,
Et terram miscere mari, dum sperat & audet,
Christicolas uno penitus delere Britannos
Funere. Feruet opus, subitoque Hispania motu
Imponit non visa prius spectacula Ponto.
Arte nova glomeratur humus: nova machina naves
Instruit, Oceano portatur & hospita tellus:
Quanta mole solum (vos o qui conditis arces)
Exuvitur[?], tanta salis humida terga premuntur.
Mox tegitur spumans prae vastis navibus aequor,
Atque avide petitur certantibus Anglia remis.
Iam praesens oculis sua praeda voratur Iberis.
Anglus at intrepide (victor Deus ipse iubebat)
Auspiciis pugnam captat tentare secundis,
Obruit Hispanam flammanti fulgure classem,
Undaque in igne furit, crepitans furit ignis in unda,
Turbidus & piceis caecatur nubibus aer,
Hispanoque rubet spumanti sanguine Pontus.
Nil iactura iuvat, tremulis nihil arma lacertis.
Reliquiae aduersis currunt Aquilonibus aequor,
Esca mari, risus terra, ludibria ventis.
I. C.

page.notes: Verse lines are run together within one paragraph, since the poem is set as a single stanza; the line breaks of the original are not reproduced. "Exuvitur" is doubtful: the letters are written as a ligatured "uu"/"ui" and may be read differently. "crepitans" is read from a tilde over the a. Long s is given as s throughout. The "u" and "v" letters follow the rule for vowels and consonants. Several words are set with ligatures (for example "ct" in "actus", "ia" in "iactura"), which were read from the print.
